body:
_This is part 3 of the series "e-commerce demo"._

## Description

This adds the widget styles for the e-commerce theme. It doesn't yet add the demo-specific widget styles.

## Notes

- The theme styles are overriding the CSS classes generated by InstantSearch to later be extracted as a theme
- The styles are alphabetically ordered
- The main SearchBox style is part of the demo style (next PR)
- The Hits style is part of the demo style (next PR)
- The outlines were removed for now, waiting for a specific design
- The Panel for the RangeInput takes the RangeSlider into account in the demo styles (next PR)
- The RangeInput "Go" button remains unstyled because the design is missing
- The ToggleRefinement style is by default aligned on the left (the demo styles will reverse the order in the next PR)
- RatingMenu selected style is temporary until we've got a designer's POV

## Preview

[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3801--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/)

## Related

- [E-commerce demo design](https://app.zeplin.io/project/5acc8becfc0c980068fc12cc/screen/5cd1a7992e4f02039b5a8336)

Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit d737269214bbaf3d03c1f04743515a5f921880ab

https://deploy-preview-3801--instantsearchjs.netlify.com

- main search bar has wrong styling - opacity of the "active" clear filters is too low I think - triangle for the hierarchical menu should be pointing rightwards instead of upwards when disabled - because the visual height of the slider is smaller, the touch target became somewhat too small now - images aren't the same height

@Haroenv As said in the description, the main search box is part of the demo style (next PR).

> opacity of the "active" clear filters is too low I think

That's part of Nico's design but I agree. I think we should do a pass later on accessibility.

> triangle for the hierarchical menu should be pointing rightwards instead of upwards when disabled

I didn't style the design that we didn't receive yet but that's a good idea I think.

> because the visual height of the slider is smaller, the touch target became somewhat too small now

Well spotted! I usually only use the handlers.

> images aren't the same height

This is part of next PR. The hits are specific to the demo.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/58104311-deaab480-7be4-11e9-89a5-f9a9aed23bb9.png)

The buttons on the panel could have a `cursor: pointer`. It's not obvious that it's clickable.
